description: This file defines the PHP class Opencart.Admin.Controller.Extension.Opencart.Total.Credit, which manages the admin interface for the 'credit' total extension in OpenCart. It includes methods for displaying the configuration page and saving settings related to the credit total.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Controller class for managing the credit total extension in the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the configuration page for the credit total extension, including breadcrumbs and other interface elements.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving of the credit total extension settings via POST request with permission validation.
